title: True waterproof PASS
notes: Clean positive. Judge should cite the waterproof phrase.

title: Negation trap
notes: If Judge cites only 'waterproof' and ignores 'Not', it's a NEGATION_MISSED fail.

title: Accessory trap
criterion_text: Product must be a jacket, size M (not an accessory for a jacket)
notes: All keywords match but product type is wrong.

title: Refurbished trap
notes: 'like-new' is NOT new. Judge must not be fooled.

title: Hidden subscription trap
criterion_text: Product must be a one-time purchase with no subscription or auto-renew
notes: Proof is far from main product lines. Judge must read whole page.

title: No proof - must say uncertain
notes: 'Lightweight' is not a number. Correct answer is uncertain, any satisfied/not_satisfied is WRONG_VERDICT.
